title: Messages
pickBody: Choose a chat from the list, or start a new one.

list.emptyBody: Start a message to a colleague or a family — everything stays in one safe place.

thread.emptyBody: Say selam — your message lands here and in their notifications.
thread.sendFailed: Could not send. Check your connection and try again.
thread.readOnly: You can read this conversation but not post in it.
thread.auditBanner: You are viewing this family conversation as a supervisor. This access is recorded.

composer.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings.
composer.smsHintMedia: Texts everyone — the photo or file goes out as a tap-through link.

approval.pageSubtitle: Teacher messages to families wait here for your approval before the family sees them.
approval.sentForApproval: Sent to the director for approval. The family will see it once approved.
approval.composerNotice: Messages you send here are reviewed by the director before the family sees them.
approval.approved: Approved and delivered to the family.
approval.rejectSubtitle: The family will never see it. Your note helps the teacher rephrase and resend.
approval.emptyBody: New teacher messages to families will appear here for your review.

info.title: Conversation details
info.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {name} from this group? They will stop receiving new messages here.
info.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? You will stop receiving new messages here.

newChat.title: New message
newChat.subtitle: Everything stays inside Temari — safe, searchable, and on the record.
newChat.searchStudents: Search students by name or ID
newChat.familyHint: Pick a student — the conversation opens with their guardians.
newChat.noFamilyPartners: No school contacts yet — they appear once your child has an active enrollment.
newChat.adminsOnlyHint: Only school leadership can post; members read and react.
newChat.familyScopeHint: Narrow to certain grades or classes — leave empty to reach every family.

launcher.title: Chat
launcher.pickChildBody: Conversations are per student. Pick the child — the thread opens with {name} and the child's other guardians.
launcher.noChildren: No linked students yet — link a child first to message this family.

forward.title: Forward to…
forward.subtitle: {count} message(s) will be copied to the chat you pick.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.subtitle: Preset messages teachers can send to families — written once in every language.
templates.name: Name
templates.scopeHint: School-wide templates appear at every branch; a branch template only at that branch.
templates.bodyPlaceholder: Write the message. Placeholders are replaced automatically.
templates.placeholdersHint: These placeholders fill in automatically when a teacher picks the template:
templates.bodyRequired: Write the message in at least one language.
templates.emptyBody: Create preset messages your teachers can send to families with one tap — in the family’s own language.
templates.empty: No templates for this conversation yet.
templates.requiredNotice: Your school requires preset messages when writing to families.
